# Kandinsky 2.0

AI Forever · released 2022-11

Comparison-only, proposed so the Kandinsky 2.1 card's COCO-30k FID table counts. 'Kandinsky 2.0 (2022)' in that table = the AI Forever (Sber AI) multilingual latent diffusion model released as ai-forever/Kandinsky\_2.0 (sha 04e8fc7ea945965edfcb33705ac272d14b9d0f6c, created 2022-11-22, apache-2.0; card: 'Kandinsky 2.0 — the first multilingual text2image model', 'UNet size: 1.2B parameters', text encoders mCLIP-XLMR 560M + mT5-encoder-small 146M). The 2.1 card says 2.1 kept 'the UNet diffusion block from Kandinsky 2.0'. params\_b is the UNet only. Not Kandinsky 2.1/2.2 or the earlier ruDALL-E 'Kandinsky 1.0'.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/Kandinsky_2.0)

Published measurements are available, but there is not enough shared evaluation data to calculate a comparable overall score yet.
